meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你把消息渠道（如 Telegram、Slack）连到代理组，管理会话隔离级别（共享/独立），添加新渠道或群组，并重新配置现有连接。先检查配置，再询问细节并执行注册命令。
howto.when: 在添加新渠道之后、初始设置过程中，或需要单独重新配置现有渠道连接时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入一个新的 Telegram 群到代理组。
say.note: Claude 会询问隔离级别并注册。

say.text: 把现有的 Slack 频道改接到另一个代理组。
say.note: 旧会话保留，新消息走新组。

say.text: 显示当前所有渠道和代理组的连接情况。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you connect messaging channels (e.g., Telegram, Slack) to agent groups, manage session isolation (shared/separate), add new channels or groups, and reconfigure existing connections. It first checks configuration, then asks details and runs registration commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered after adding a channel, during initial setup, or when reconfiguring existing channel connections standalone.

say_en.text: Help me connect a new Telegram group to an agent group.
say_en.note: Claude asks isolation level and registers.

say_en.text: Move the existing Slack channel to another agent group.
say_en.note: Old sessions stay; new messages go to new group.

say_en.text: Show a summary of all channel and agent group connections.
